verdict.rationale: Alloy is a KYC/AML decisioning platform, so PEP screening is a fair axis for it. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of identifying politically exposed persons, their relatives or close associates, or supporting source context. The only related items are generic: AML checks and a passing mention of watchlist updates triggering webhooks. Neither is evidence of this capability.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can identify politically exposed persons and related associates with supporting source context
